native_sources.name: admin_notices
native_sources.notes: Ephemeral admin-screen notice substrate; not a durable per-user Notification Instance.

native_sources.name: Roles & Capabilities
native_sources.notes: Authorization/recipient input substrate only; canonical role truth remains delegated.

native_sources.name: WP-Cron
native_sources.notes: Scheduling substrate owned by the Cron/Job surface.

native_sources.name: wp_mail()
native_sources.notes: Email transport/output primitive owned by Surface 20, not Notifications.

records.label: Typed Event / Registered Action Binding
records.notes: Event-driven rules are parity; only registered typed adapters may bind triggers.

records.label: Condition Engine Reference
records.notes: Conditional workflows are market-evidenced while the reusable condition engine remains canonical/delegated.

records.label: Query / Role / Membership Recipient References
records.notes: Roles/users/groups/queries may feed recipients, but their canonical owners remain read-only sources.

records.label: Authorization / Preference / Quiet-Hours Eligibility
records.notes: User preferences are market parity; WPE retains server authorization and deterministic quiet-hours eligibility.

records.label: Priority / Requiredness Classification
records.notes: Portable priority/requiredness semantics remain an explicit WPE contract rather than provider-label inference.

records.label: In-App / Email / Webhook Channel Routing
records.notes: In-app/web/email channels are market parity; Email/Webhook execution stays delegated to transport owners.

records.label: In-App Content / Allowlisted Token Schema
records.notes: Templated notification content is parity; tokens stay typed and allowlisted.

records.label: Immediate / Delay / Date-Time / Timezone Policy
records.notes: Scheduled notification patterns exist, but execution remains Cron-owned and timezone/delay guarantees explicit.

records.label: Dedupe / Frequency Cap Policy
records.notes: Generic dedupe/frequency-cap guarantees are retained as WPE-exceed policy.

records.label: Digest / Grouping / Overflow Policy
records.notes: Digest/grouping/overflow semantics are retained as explicit WPE policy.

records.label: Inbox Instance State / Expiry
records.notes: All/unread/read/remove style durable per-user states are market-evidenced.

records.label: Delivery State / Retry / Idempotency
records.notes: Retry/idempotency/delivery evidence differs by channel/provider; acceptance never automatically equals end-user delivery.

records.label: User Preferences / Retention / Health / Bounded Fan-Out
records.notes: Per-user preferences are market parity; retention/health and bounded fan-out remain explicit WPE reliability limits.

records.label: Arbitrary Hook / Executable Callback
records.notes: Raw user-authored hook names/callbacks remain rejected; only registered typed event adapters may be referenced.

coverage.notes: All Notifications records are native/market classified. Rules/recipients/channels/content/inbox/preferences are market parity; priority/scheduling/dedupe/digest/delivery guarantees remain WPE hardening, transports remain delegated and raw hooks stay rejected.
